Gravity Flip
=============

A minimalist HTML canvas game where the player controls a small ball that bounces on rotating platforms. Tap or click to flip gravity, causing the ball to stick to the ceiling instead of the floor. The platform rotation and gravity flips create a rhythm‑based challenge.

**Lose condition:** The player loses if the ball falls off the bottom or top edge of the canvas (i.e., leaves the visible area).

1: // Minimalist Gravity Flip game – enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Set up a subtle radial background gradient
6:   const bgGradient = (() => {
7:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width/2, height/2, Math.min(width, height)*0.1, width/2, height/2, Math.max(width, height));
8:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#222');
9:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
10:     return grad;
11:   })();
12:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
13:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
14:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
15:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
16:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
17: 
18:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
19:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
20:   // Helper to play a simple beep
21:   function playBeep(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') {
22:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
23:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
24:     osc.type = type;
25:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
26:     osc.connect(gain);
27:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
30:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
31:     osc.start();
32:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
33:   }
34:   // Ensure AudioContext is resumed on first user interaction
35:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
36:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
37:     gravityDir *= -1;
38:     playBeep(440, 0.08); // flip sound
39:   });
40: 
41:   const BALL_RADIUS = 10;
42:   const GRAVITY = 0.3; // acceleration per frame
43:   const PLATFORM_LENGTH = Math.min(width, height) * 0.8;
44:   const PLATFORM_SPEED = 0.01; // radians per frame
45: 
46:   let gravityDir = 1; // 1 = down, -1 = up
47:   // click listener now handles gravity flip and sound
48: 
49:   const ball = {
50:     x: width / 2,
51:     y: height / 2,
52:     vx: 0,
53:     vy: 0,
54:     radius: BALL_RADIUS,
55:     update() {
56:       // apply gravity
57:       this.vy += GRAVITY * gravityDir;
58:       this.x += this.vx;
59:       this.y += this.vy;
60:     },
61: draw() {
62:         // radial gradient for a 3‑D sphere look
63:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x - this.radius/3, this.y - this.radius/3, this.radius/5, this.x, this.y, this.radius);
64:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a65');
65:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#d84315');
66:         ctx.beginPath();
67:         ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
68:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
69:         ctx.fill();
70:         // subtle white highlight
71:         ctx.beginPath();
72:         ctx.arc(this.x - this.radius/3, this.y - this.radius/3, this.radius/3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
73:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
74:         ctx.fill();
75:       }
76:   };
77: 
78:   const platform = {
79:     angle: 0,
80:     update() {
81:       this.angle += PLATFORM_SPEED;
82:     },
83:     // return end points of the rotating line (centered)
84:     getPoints() {
85:       const cx = width / 2;
86:       const cy = height / 2;
87:       const half = PLATFORM_LENGTH / 2;
88:       const cos = Math.cos(this.angle);
89:       const sin = Math.sin(this.angle);
90:       const x1 = cx - half * cos;
91:       const y1 = cy - half * sin;
92:       const x2 = cx + half * cos;
93:       const y2 = cy + half * sin;
94:       return { x1, y1, x2, y2 };
95:     },
96:     draw() {
97:       const { x1, y1, x2, y2 } = this.getPoints();
98:       // gradient stroke for depth
99:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x1, y1, x2, y2);
100:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#90caf9');
101:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#1e88e5');
102:       ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
103:       ctx.lineWidth = 10;
104:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
105:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
106:       ctx.beginPath();
107:       ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
108:       ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
109:       ctx.stroke();
110:       // reset shadow
111:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
112:     }
113:   };
114: 
115:   // Helper: distance from point to line segment
116:   function pointLineDist(px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
117:     const A = px - x1;
118:     const B = py - y1;
119:     const C = x2 - x1;
120:     const D = y2 - y1;
121:     const dot = A * C + B * D;
122:     const lenSq = C * C + D * D;
123:     let param = -1;
124:     if (lenSq !== 0) param = dot / lenSq;
125:     let xx, yy;
126:     if (param < 0) {
127:       xx = x1; yy = y1;
128:     } else if (param > 1) {
129:       xx = x2; yy = y2;
130:     } else {
131:       xx = x1 + param * C;
132:       yy = y1 + param * D;
133:     }
134:     const dx = px - xx;
135:     const dy = py - yy;
136:     return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
137:   }
138: 
139:   // Collision handling – simple stick to platform when nearing from gravity direction
140:   function handleCollision() {
141:     const { x1, y1, x2, y2 } = platform.getPoints();
142:     const dist = pointLineDist(ball.x, ball.y, x1, y1, x2, y2);
143:     if (dist < ball.radius) {
144:       // Determine which side of the line the ball is on
145:       const side = (ball.x - x1) * (y2 - y1) - (ball.y - y1) * (x2 - x1);
146:       // side > 0 means one side, <0 the opposite
147:       const shouldStick = (gravityDir === 1 && side > 0) || (gravityDir === -1 && side < 0);
148:       if (shouldStick) {
149:           // play a short impact sound
150:           playBeep(660, 0.05, 'triangle');
151:         // Project ball onto line to keep it on surface
152:         const t = ((ball.x - x1) * (x2 - x1) + (ball.y - y1) * (y2 - y1)) / ((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2);
153:         const projX = x1 + t * (x2 - x1);
154:         const projY = y1 + t * (y2 - y1);
155:         // Move ball to surface
156:         const normal = Math.sqrt((ball.x - projX) ** 2 + (ball.y - projY) ** 2);
157:         const moveFactor = (ball.radius - normal) / normal;
158:         ball.x = ball.x + (ball.x - projX) * moveFactor;
159:         ball.y = ball.y + (ball.y - projY) * moveFactor;
160:         // Cancel velocity perpendicular to platform
161:         const vx = ball.vx;
162:         const vy = ball.vy;
163:         const nx = -(y2 - y1);
164:         const ny = x2 - x1;
165:         const len = Math.hypot(nx, ny);
166:         const nxu = nx / len;
167:         const nyu = ny / len;
168:         const perp = vx * nxu + vy * nyu;
169:         ball.vx = vx - perp * nxu;
170:         ball.vy = vy - perp * nyu;
171:         // Add small friction along platform
172:         ball.vx *= 0.99;
173:         ball.vy *= 0.99;
174:       }
175:     }
176:   }
177: 
178:   function loseCheck() {
179:     if (ball.y - ball.radius > height || ball.y + ball.radius < 0) {
180:       // Reset game state
181:       ball.x = width / 2;
182:       ball.y = height / 2;
183:       ball.vx = 0;
184:       ball.vy = 0;
185:       gravityDir = 1;
186:     }
187:   }
188: 
189:   function loop() {
190:     // Update background gradient with subtle hue shift
191:     const hue = (Date.now() * 0.02) % 360;
192:     const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width/2, height/2, Math.min(width, height)*0.1, width/2, height/2, Math.max(width, height));
193:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${hue},30%,20%)`);
194:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${(hue+60)%360},30%,10%)`);
195:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
196:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
197:     platform.update();
198:     platform.draw();
199:     ball.update();
200:     handleCollision();
201:     ball.draw();
202:     loseCheck();
203:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
204:   }
205: 
206:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207: })();

(End of file - total 207 lines)
</content>
